method.cleared_set: a song is cleared when a record built from exactly the evidenced file passes evidenceRefusal (src/dataset/package-public.ts): arrangement_license in REDISTRIBUTABLE_ARRANGEMENT_LICENSES and title_verdict not 'contradicts'. A v0 window record is judged by evidenceRefusal on itself, sidecar hash included.
method.note_level: an encoding from which individual pitches can be read: hand strings, runs of 4+ pitch names, REMI Pitch tokens, ABC tunes, piano-roll rectangles, MIDI-number arrays, note fields and events
method.measurement_level: values measured on a take of the song: f0, cents off target, onset offsets (data files only)
method.metadata_only: ids, titles, chord symbols, labels, counts, prose, and single pitches
method.floors: data files (json, jsonl, log, svg): one unit is a finding; prose and code: four note units
method.composition_rule: US public domain = first published 1930 or earlier; EU public domain = every author died 1955 or earlier (as of 2026)
